title: Anyone been to any of these infinite houses
content: Infinite brothel: It seems to exist in the same realm as other infinite houses that I’ve been to in dreams. Although it is slightly less haunted, it still takes on an ethereal quality, and you are able to walk through room after room before actually getting where you are going. There are endless girls that live inside the house and you can choose any number of them to have any kind of sexual experience you want, even having orgies and very perverted things happening. No one ever judges you because this entire house was created for your pleasure. Not only that but the hypermodern futuristic yet Victorian architecture makes it one of the most beatiful places you ever ever seen in a dream. You would truly want to stay here forever but it seems you are only allowed to come when you’ve been gifted a session by the dream entities. And when you are gifted a session you are guaranteed to receive it unlike other dream locations. Infinite horror challenge castle: this one is the most ethereal and hardest to describe from memory, it feels like you’re on acid when you’re in here it’s so far removed from normal reality. It’s heavily populated with other dreamers but everyone is equally confused as to how they got there or what exactly is the purpose of it. There are many rooms but you seem to unlock them as you g further and further. But sometimes things will shift and you won’t be where you thought you were. Has the effect where once the doors of the room close you are no longer able to return back, you are no longer subject to normal dream rules, and you are no longer allowed to awaken except by hard awakening. The rooms will shift and change often when you aren’t looking, you’re guaranteed to get lost or even trapped. It is not known whether anyone has completed the challenge. Extreme horror scare hotel: this one has no main entrance or corridor, you seem to just no clip into one of the rooms and you are instantly terrified but you have no idea why. You’re always the only human here but you feel surrounded by entities you can’t see that feel so demonic and terrifying and otherworldly that it makes every hair on your neck stand ups. The rooms are liminal, looking like scenes from a Stephen King movie, the floors are crooked and slanted, you feel the overwhelming sense that something is not right, and you shouldn’t be here. You might also see clothing especially winter coats. You should never under any circumstances put on any of the clothing. House of healers: This is a house populated by psychic dreamers. Psychonauts, lucid dreamers etc. basically a hub to interface and share knowledge. You’ll encounter light workers , star seeds, spiritual masters, explorers. And all sorts of interesting characters. You’ll feel like you’re sitting at a table with the most interesting and highest vibrational people you’ve ever encountered. Some of them may not exist in earthly realms because they have transcended. Others are earthly beings like yourself that have been invited. This one is again invite only similar to the infinite brothel. Infinite water park home: at times this place appears to be outside but it is in reality all contained within the structures of an infinite mansion. Some areas are more like an indoor water park and some are an expansive outdoor water park. You can float endlessly through passages between rooms and enter more or less active areas. The inner tubes you are given can also float through the air. You are encouraged to act as if you are a child once again. Despite being the most overpopulated home it is still fairly luxurious feature shining natural light and expansive waterfalls and fixtures though occasionally certain areas will have a cheap childlike quality to them for nostalgia.
